attack_techniques: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting (T1558.003)
attackers_goals: Crack account credentials by obtaining an easy-to-crack Kerberos ticket.
description: A user enumerated all service principals in the organization and specifically requested weak and deprecated encryption in a ticket request. This is typically a sign of a Kerberoasting attack.
investigative_actions: Check who used the host at the time of the alert to rule out a benign service or tool requesting weak Kerberos encryption.
name: Possible Kerberoasting attack
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
